name: manual_053d2b
claim: Never teach a command or regex through prose that two repositories copy by hand. Keep one block between sentinel comments, execute its commands against a throwaway fixture in a test, pin its hash, and compare it with the sibling repository's copy when both checkouts exist; a pin alone cannot catch one repository editing its block and its own pin together.

decisions.notes: Conflict-marker scan wording in the lockstep PR pair was re-flagged in five review rounds because it was hand-synced prose judged by eye. Independent reviews by Codex and a W&B-hosted Cline agent then found false claims only fixtures and a grep of the real repository exposed: reST underlines are not leftover separators, quoted markers are not conflicts, ignored files are not searched. A one-sided edit of block plus pin passed the pin and failed only the sibling comparison.
